arguments.analyst: Round 2: O1/O2 high brightness, O4/O5 collapse; observed data favor position 41/43 (O9 3.70) and charge-rich mutations, penalizing E95G alone (O7 1.30).
arguments.hypothesis: Combining the O9 T43A/K41T context with charge-neutral substitutions (D117G, E172V, K79R) raises log brightness above 3.8; E95G in combination is deleterious unless paired as in O2.

decision.analyst: Round 2: O1/O2 high brightness, O4/O5 collapse; observed data favor position 41/43 (O9 3.70) and charge-rich mutations, penalizing E95G alone (O7 1.30).
decision.hypothesis: Combining the O9 T43A/K41T context with charge-neutral substitutions (D117G, E172V, K79R) raises log brightness above 3.8; E95G in combination is deleterious unless paired as in O2.
decision.critic: All estimates cluster 3.57-3.61, far below O1/O9 observed 3.7-3.87; models underpredict top mutants, so ranking is weak.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize C32 and C31 (T43A/K41R context from O9) plus C16, C35, C41: highest estimates, low uncertainty, distinct scaffolds.
